modeAskHint: Nobody can approve actions from Telegram, so anything risky (file edits, commands) is declined. Good for just looking around or asking questions.
modeEditsHint: Claude edits project files without asking; risky commands are declined.
modeFullHint: Any files, commands and internet access without limits. Use with care.
cmdStatus: What's selected and whether a task is running
help:
Claude Desk remote control.

Just send a task: Claude will run it on your computer in the selected project and send back the answer.

/projects — list projects
/project <number or name> — pick a project
/chats — recent chats in the project
/chat <number> — continue a chat
/new — the next message starts a new chat
/mode ask|edits|full — permissions (ask / allow edits / full access)
/status — what's selected and whether a task is running
/stop — stop the current task
/help — this help
needConfig: Set the bot token and your chat id in the Telegram settings first
needPrivateChat: Remote control needs your personal chat id (a number), not a channel or group
conflict: This bot is already receiving messages elsewhere (a webhook or another program with the same token)
chatNotFound: Chat not found. Send /start to your bot and check the chat id
forbidden: The bot is blocked or can't post to this chat
noProjects: No projects yet. Create a project in Claude Desk or start a chat there in the folder you need.
noProjectSelected:
No project selected. New chats start in the default folder.
Pick one: /projects
projectPicked:
📁 Project "{name}" — {folder}
The next message starts a new chat in it. To continue an existing one: /chats
noChats: No chats {where} yet. Just send a task and I'll start a new one.
nextNewChat: The next message starts a new chat. Chat list: /chats
chatNumberRequired: Give a chat number from the list: /chats
noSuchChat: No chat with that number. List: /chats
newChat: ✨ The next message starts a new chat.
newChatIn: ✨ The next message starts a new chat in "{name}".
alreadyBusy: ⏳ Still working on the previous task, /stop to cancel it.
folderNotFound:
❌ Folder not found: {path}
Pick another project: /projects
textOnly: I only understand text for now.
enabled: 🟢 Telegram remote control is on. Send a task, or /help for the command list.
